component.name: Limpa Tudo
component.summary: Libere espaço em disco com segurança
Libera espacio en disco con seguridad

description.p: Limpa Tudo finds developer caches (node_modules, Python venvs, npm, pip, Gradle, Maven, Cargo, Android emulators), system junk (logs, temp files, thumbnails) and the caches of common apps (Chrome, Firefox, Slack, Discord, VS Code), shows the full path and size of every item and only moves what you pick to the Trash.

ul.li: Never deletes anything on its own: scan and removal are separate steps
Moves to the Trash by default; permanent deletion is an advanced opt-in
Only looks at a curated list of known cache paths
Checks whether an app is running before touching its cache
Every item is labeled low, medium or high risk

description.p: O Limpa Tudo encontra caches de desenvolvimento, dados de sistema e cache de apps, mostra o caminho e o tamanho de cada item e só manda para a Lixeira o que você escolher.
